clientPaymentSchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_payments (
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, client TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id),
account TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), date TEXT NOT NULL,
amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount)='integer' AND amount BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS client_payments_client ON client_payments(client);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS client_payments_account ON client_payments(account);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sales_client ON sales(client);
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS client_totals AS
coalesce((SELECT sum(total) FROM sales WHERE client=c.id),0) AS purchases,
coalesce((SELECT sum(total-paid) FROM sales WHERE client=c.id),0)
- coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM client_payments WHERE client=c.id),0) AS debt
clientTotals: SELECT purchases, debt FROM client_totals WHERE id=@client
clientHistory: SELECT s.*, sum(total-paid) OVER (ORDER BY date,rowid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS runningDebt
payments AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) AS total FROM client_payments WHERE client=@client)
SELECT 'sale:' || s.id AS id, 'sale' AS kind, s.date, s.paid, s.total-s.paid AS debt,
FROM (SELECT name,qty,unit FROM sale_lines WHERE sale=s.id ORDER BY rowid)) AS items
FROM purchases s CROSS JOIN payments
SELECT 'payment:' || p.id, 'payment', p.date, p.amount, -p.amount, 0, p.employee, a.name, '[]'
FROM client_payments p JOIN accounts a ON a.id=p.account WHERE p.client=@client
existingClientPayment: SELECT client, account, amount FROM client_payments WHERE id=@id
postClientPayment: INSERT INTO client_payments (id, client, account, date, amount, employee)
FROM client_totals WHERE id=@client AND @amount BETWEEN 1 AND debt
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts WHERE id=@account)
invalidClientDebt: SELECT 1 FROM client_totals WHERE debt<0 LIMIT 1
